title: Deroon Dero Dero
overview:
Aim for a 100-chain!! The super-chain falling block game has arrived!

7 chains! 8 chains! 9 chains! Super chains with stretchy dero!! Chaining all at once feels great!

The new modes are seriously fun!!

In addition to the arcade mode, it includes three new modes!!

目指せ！100連鎖!!超連鎖落ちゲー登場！

7連鎖！8連鎖！9連鎖！のび～るでろで超連鎖!!一気に連鎖で、気持ちい～！

ニュ～モ～ドがなまら面白い!!

業務用モードのほかに、3つのニューモードを搭載!!
